groups.name: Thin top utility bar
groups.definition: Is there a thin utility bar above the header holding secondary links, contact details or similar?

groups.name: Full-width announcement bar
groups.definition: Is there a full-width announcement bar at the top of the page carrying a short message or link?

groups.name: Full-width promo or CTA band
groups.definition: Is there a full-width colored or gray promotional band with a heading or text and a call to action?

groups.name: Fully rounded pill primary buttons
groups.definition: Are the primary call-to-action buttons fully rounded pills?

groups.name: Outlined ghost buttons
groups.definition: Are secondary or all buttons transparent or outlined with a thin border rather than filled?

groups.name: Square or small-radius solid buttons
groups.definition: Are the primary buttons solid rectangles with square or small-radius corners?

groups.name: Mostly square corners, no pills
groups.definition: Are corners predominantly square or slightly rounded, with no pill shapes?

groups.name: White bordered rounded cards
groups.definition: Are cards white with thin borders and rounded corners, with no heavy shadow?

groups.name: Thick left accent border blocks
groups.definition: Do cards or callouts have a thick accent-colored left border?

groups.name: Section heading with View All link
groups.definition: Do section headings have a right-aligned 'View all' style link?

groups.name: Arrow-terminated text links
groups.definition: Are secondary calls to action text links ending in an arrow glyph rather than buttons?

groups.name: Dark footer band
groups.definition: Is the footer a dark band with light text?

groups.name: Minimal footer legal row
groups.definition: Is the footer or its bottom row minimal, with copyright, a few links or payment icons?

groups.name: Text-only social links
groups.definition: Are social links plain text labels without icons?

groups.name: Icon social links
groups.definition: Are social links presented as icons or icon-plus-label items?

groups.name: Text wordmark brand
groups.definition: Is the brand shown as a text wordmark instead of a logo image?

groups.name: Logo-left nav-right header
groups.definition: Does the header place the logo at left and navigation links at right?

groups.name: Sticky overlay header
groups.definition: Is the header sticky or fixed, overlaying content, possibly translucent?

groups.name: Highlighted active nav item
groups.definition: Is the active navigation item visually highlighted as a tab or fill?

groups.name: Email signup form
groups.definition: Is there a simple email signup form with an input and a button?

groups.name: Search form with input and button
groups.definition: Is there a prominent search form pairing an input with a button?

groups.name: Labeled form fields
groups.definition: Do forms use visible labels with native inputs and selects?

groups.name: Dark inputs with placeholders
groups.definition: Are form inputs dark-filled boxes, possibly without visible labels?

groups.name: Full-width sidebar or form button
groups.definition: Is there a button spanning the full width of its form or card?

groups.name: Pill chips and filter tabs
groups.definition: Are there pill-shaped chips, filters or tags as a row?

groups.name: Square-cornered label badges
groups.definition: Are badges or labels sharp-cornered rectangles?

groups.name: Pill category badges on cards
groups.definition: Do cards carry small pill-shaped badges or tags?

groups.name: Image-top cards with title
groups.definition: Do cards stack an image on top followed by title and text in a consistent order?

groups.name: Cards without images
groups.definition: Are cards or tiles text-only, with no thumbnails or photos?

groups.name: Carousel
groups.definition: Does the page have a carousel or slider?

groups.name: Circular avatars
groups.definition: Are circular avatars or author photos used?

groups.name: Ruled divider lists
groups.definition: Are lists separated by thin horizontal divider lines?

groups.name: Styled inline text links
groups.definition: Are inline links colored or underlined in a consistent accent style?

groups.name: Quick-link tile grid
groups.definition: Is there a grid of quick-link tiles or columns?

groups.name: Numbered pagination
groups.definition: Is there numbered pagination with a highlighted current page?

groups.name: Dark feature cards
groups.definition: Are there dark-filled cards or tiles with white text?

groups.name: Person or community cards
groups.definition: Are there cards for people or communities showing name and a secondary line?

groups.name: Hidden dialog form
groups.definition: Is a hidden dialog or modal with a labeled form in the DOM?

groups.name: Logo on rounded tile
groups.definition: Does the logo sit on a rounded white tile with a shadow?

groups.name: Multi-column cream footer with newsletter
groups.definition: Is the footer a cream multi-column block with tracked uppercase headings and newsletter?

groups.name: Statistics tile grid
groups.definition: Are statistics shown as a grid of tiles with large numbers?

groups.name: Language selector buttons
groups.definition: Is there a language selector with flag buttons?

groups.name: Centered icon cards
groups.definition: Do cards center an icon, uppercase title and description?

groups.name: Accessibility aids
groups.definition: Are accessibility aids such as text-size controls present?

groups.name: Circular check bullet list
groups.definition: Does the hero list benefits with circular check icons?

groups.name: Detached photo credit caption
groups.definition: Is photo credit a small dark caption box detached from its image?

groups.name: Bold accent product prices
groups.definition: Are product names bold dark and prices bold accent pinned to card bottom?

groups.name: Italic serif pull quote
groups.definition: Are pull quotes italic serif blockquotes with a colored left border?

groups.name: Trending strip
groups.definition: Is there a trending strip with an accent label and truncated post titles?

groups.name: Empty card bodies
groups.definition: Do some cards have empty bodies leaving blank space?

groups.name: Struck-through old price
groups.definition: Does pricing show a struck-through old price beside a larger new price?

groups.name: Photo band with overlay text
groups.definition: Is there a full-width photo band with dark overlay and centered text?

groups.name: Footer link sequence numbers
groups.definition: Do footer links carry small numbers after each label?

groups.name: Mobile-only menu toggle
groups.definition: Is there a menu toggle hidden on desktop?

groups.name: News rows with date block
groups.definition: Do news rows show a date block, headline and read-more link in a row?

groups.name: Numbered step cards
groups.definition: Is there a row of cards with numbered circle badges?

groups.name: Testimonial cards with stars
groups.definition: Are testimonials equal-height cards with star ratings and no photos?

groups.name: Text-only auth buttons panel
groups.definition: Are auth options text-only buttons in a bordered panel?

groups.name: Back-to-top link
groups.definition: Does the page end with a centered back-to-top link with an arrow?

groups.name: Minimal logo-only header
groups.definition: Is the header just a logo at far left with no nav?

groups.name: Gradient or color band logo statement
groups.definition: Is there a colored band with a logo above a centered white statement?

groups.name: Square-cornered accent search button
groups.definition: Is there a flat inverted promo button on a banner?

groups.name: A wide gray banner cross-promotes a related product line wit
groups.definition: A wide gray banner cross-promotes a related product line with a button.

groups.name: Each section heading has a dark horizontal rule beneath it,
groups.definition: Each section heading has a dark horizontal rule beneath it, with a right-aligned 'All … →' link on the label line.
